under its exact publication basis.

concepts.definition: Declared source-member imports into reference-frame-evaluation: FOUNDATIONS §2 supplies evaluation/family, workspace, material-relation manifold, coordinate, topology, capability envelope, reference/activated frame, frame set/configuration, lens, role/persona/abstraction/component; subject/outcome/basis/material relation/evidence/actor/claim/judgment/residual; frame-set/semantic/evaluation/operation/decision authority and actor identity; disjointness and evaluation/assurance independence; and tuple ⟨Q, B, M, C, I, A, E, X, R, J, K, D⟩. FOUNDATIONS §4 supplies core values, meaning/standing, evaluation-not-performed, refinements and conjunction/composition with decision rule. ACTIVATION §§1–2 supplies step intake/admission/applicability/context sizing/activation/evaluation, §3 result refinements/disposition, §7 closed result/reuse. EVALUATION §7 supplies frame/method qualification. These three source members declare no bounded-context identity, so each source context is its member.

grounding.quote:
FOUNDATIONS, ACTIVATION and
EVALUATION declare no bounded-context identity, so each row's source
context is its member
| qualification of a frame and of this method | EVALUATION | [Qualification of frames and of the method](EVALUATION.md#7-qualification-of-frames-and-of-the-method), EVALUATION §7 |

concepts.label: Reference-frame imported concept inventory

conditions: A complete consumer update is planned or applied.

grounding.quote:
Mutation requires
explicit acceptance of this exact plan and re-derives it; possession of its
digest alone grants no operation authority.

constraints.statement: The acceptance object binds physical destinations, binding preimages, exact cohort bytes, companion annotated tags/commits/subtrees/inventories, replacement dependency locators, native routes and declared derived-source observations using the referenced canonical JSON hashing rule. Already-installed status grants no authority and changes no digest. Mutation requires explicit acceptance and re-derivation of this exact plan; digest possession alone is insufficient. Directory proximity and empty discovery cannot select scope. adopt, sync and fleet retain their narrower contracts.
constraints.uncertainty: The preceding hashing rule and narrower command contracts are not supplied.

conditions: A complete update is attempted.

grounding.quote:
The complete operation verifies the selected cohort's dependency closure
and each exact companion's definition, release record and admitted members
before relying on them.

For each selected derived context, missing, ambiguous, changed or
unavailable program, map or source evidence holds the complete update
before any consumer effect.

constraints.statement: Verify cohort dependency closure and every exact companion's definition, release record and admitted members before reliance; stage absent immutable installs, verify existing ones without in-place repair, and preflight every consumer target. For every selected derived context, missing, ambiguous, changed or unavailable program/map/source evidence holds the update before consumer effects. The source owner performs needed semantic re-entry; the manager cannot relabel old maps current. Exact freshness proves integrity, not semantic conformance or an independent verdict. After staging, recheck consumer preimages and source evidence; report completion only after verifying every selected resulting binding and companion.

conditions: Application, refusal, failure or recovery of a complete update.
exceptions: Newly staged immutable installs may remain unused.

grounding.quote:
The operation requires an exclusive consumer
write scope during application. It claims no crash-atomic transaction
across independent filesystem paths:

constraints.statement: Application requires exclusive consumer write scope. Refusal before consumer effects retains prior state. Caught application failure restores affected preimages, applies no later part and cannot report completion. No crash-atomic transaction across independent paths is claimed. Abrupt process/host loss or unavailable rollback storage requires recovery from presented preimages before claiming the complete relation.

conditions: An operation has an intended external effect.

grounding.quote:
`completion_unknown`, and `not_effected` with its end
  not established, are effects of uncertain completion under
  [ACTIVATION §3 Effects](ACTIVATION.md#effects): recovery from the
  presented preimages reconciles them, as
  [ACTIVATION §5](ACTIVATION.md#5-work-state-and-restart) states, before
  any repetition or claim of the complete relation.

constraints.statement: For install, sync, mutating adopt, fleet adoption and complete updates, completed/satisfied requires evidence establishing the entire intended effect. Pre-effect refusal with retained-state evidence is not_effected/falsified with established end. Caught failure is not_effected/falsified because the whole update fell short and no later part will apply; verified restoration establishes its end, while unverified restoration or unavailable rollback storage leaves the end unestablished with a residual naming required verification. Record unused installs as partial occurrence. Abrupt loss without a caught shortfall is completion_unknown/indeterminate, never completed or not_effected. Both completion_unknown and not_effected with unestablished end require reconciliation from preimages before repetition or a complete-relation claim.

conditions: A command refuses or reports a subject condition.

grounding.quote:
A missing explicit acceptance of the
  exact plan, or missing whole-selection authorisation of a fleet write,
  is missing operation authority: `admission_refused(authority)`
  (`out_of_frame`), naming the acceptance or authorisation needed and
  its owner.

A condition it
  reports about the subject it evaluates, such as a member that `verify`
  finds missing, extra or changed, is a counterexample to that command's
  own predicate, `falsified`, not a refusal.

constraints.statement: Before operation start, refusal addresses lawful admission/activation on the exact subject and basis; after start it addresses candidate availability. Missing exact-plan acceptance or whole-selection fleet authorisation is admission_refused(authority)/out_of_frame and names the needed grant and owner. All other specified refusals are basis-caused: definition/preimage drift, stale plans, fail-closed conditions including ambiguous discovery, escaping/broken paths/locators/marker spans and defective derived evidence. They are admission_refused(basis) before start or re_entry_requested(basis) after, both invalid_basis, naming the failed coordinate and, for derived evidence, source owner. Commands with no intended external effect, such as verify or adopt --dry-run, have no Effects value; their refusals still map by cause, while detected missing/extra/changed subject members falsify their own predicate. Combining results must preserve these distinctions, never treating failure/refusal as completion, unknown completion as true or false, caught shortfall as undecided, or missing authority as defective basis.
constraints.uncertainty: The earlier fail-closed list is referenced but not supplied.

grounding.quote:
A bounded context exists only when an owning authority declares its stable
identity, owner, selected basis and governed semantic scope.

constraints.statement: Context existence requires owner declaration of stable identity, owner, selected basis and governed scope; consuming members define concepts there only by explicit owner relation. Filenames, headings, indexes, glossary sections, schema values and bare URIs do not constitute contexts. Equal spelling, capitalisation, shape, location, nesting, actor or implementation proves no meaning identity, equivalence, inheritance or authority; differing spelling proves no difference. Such relations require an applicable semantic address or explicit authorised relation. Glossary concepts apply only when the address selects the owning clause or the target explicitly imports them.

conditions: Resolving a material occurrence.
constraints.statement: Resolve in order: governed scope and nearest explicit declaration; exact basis and applicable authorities; admitted local definitions/imports; every applicable authorised override/disambiguation; admission only with exactly one remaining concept. An owning document, section, field, operation or other surface may declare context for subordinate occurrences, so uniquely resolved prose need not repeat qualifiers. Repositories, directories, names, headings, glossary matches, prompts, actors and nearby definitions do not accidentally declare context.

conditions: Zero or multiple applicable concepts remain at a material boundary.
exceptions: A dependent evaluation returns indeterminate where admissible evidence also cannot decide the claim, naming that additional ground.

grounding.quote:
Zero applicable concepts is unresolved meaning; more than one is ambiguous
meaning. Both fail closed at a material boundary:

constraints.statement: Zero candidates means unresolved, multiple means ambiguous. Agents, designs, schemas, implementations, tests, translations and reviewers must not choose by familiarity, frequency, recency, nominal match or context-free glossary fallback. A dependent evaluation returns out_of_frame, naming the missing definition/import/disambiguation relation and owner, or indeterminate under the stated evidence condition; either result names its ground.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced FOUNDATIONS result rule is not supplied beyond this local account.

conditions: A cross-context relation is declared.
constraints.statement: The explicit owner-authorised carrier must state exact source/target concept references and context identities; import/disambiguation/directional translation/equivalence kind; direction and lawful inverse where material; preserved/changed meaning, loss and refusal conditions; both semantic owners without authority transfer; both selected bases, governed scope and provenance; lifecycle and invalidation. Owners are authorities distinct from owning clauses. No kind widens either authority. Change, narrowing or loss of source meaning cannot pass as unchanged import. Equal spelling or opposing translations do not prove equivalence. Cross-context disambiguation requires a declared import, translation or equivalence for entry. Specialisation additionally identifies exact target, preserved/narrowed meaning, excluded source instances and inverse absence or law; a label alone establishes nothing.
constraints.uncertainty: FOUNDATIONS import law and AC-012 are referenced; only their stated local consequences are represented.

grounding.quote:
An empty local array explicitly declares that no local entry of that kind
is bound for the product. Omission is not an equivalent declaration

When the candidates cross bounded
contexts, that carrier also declares the complete import, translation or
equivalence relation §5 requires.

constraints.statement: File category and overlay listing grant no authority. Every entry supplies its required URI, authority, applicable clause/ambiguity and scope. Every disambiguation supplies term, context, complete disambiguates set, resolves_to as a member, all needed bases, uri, authority and applies_to. Cross-context candidates require the complete §5 import/translation/equivalence on the resolution carrier. Metadata neither restates source meanings nor creates the decision. Empty arrays explicitly declare no entry of that kind; omission does not.

grounding.quote:
Profile availability, Product adoption and execution-scoped activation are
three distinct relations.

An Agent Frame Activation does not mutate the overlay, and the overlay
registers no agents, assigns no permanent frames and persists no temporary
active frame configuration

constraints.statement: REFERENCE_FRAME supplies principles and declaration shape; the Executive profile supplies an optional profile. Neither selects, adopts or owns Product bindings. Existing Product authority owns the concrete declaration and every grant. JSON entries merely locate declarations and authority relations. Selected-cut inclusion makes a profile available, only Product authority adopts it, and only an exact authorised work instruction activates one bound frame for an actor/subject. Activation does not mutate or register agents/permanent frames/temporary configurations in the overlay. Actor names and broad frames grant no authority beyond cited owners and exact activation. Shared actors, repositories, files, implementations, outputs or tools establish no Product composition or identity. A runtime/domain/Product carrier called Frame stays under its WHAT/HOW, may be an evaluation subject/coordinate, and enters the set only by explicit frame declaration with required evaluation/authority relations.

conditions: A Product uses the project reference-frame basis template.

grounding.quote:
An adopting Product replaces every placeholder
with its own exact identities, owners, scopes, sources, grants, results and
invalidation conditions, then admits that completed declaration under
existing authority

constraints.statement: The template projects binding law into a copyable shape and supplies no authority. The adopting Product replaces every placeholder with exact identities, owners, scopes, sources, grants, results and invalidators, then admits the completed declaration under existing authority.

grounding.quote:
A separate
`TENANT_REGISTRY.md` may remain as a human-readable companion or generated
projection and cannot become a second tenant-identity or location
authority

Goals own the bounded work wave, ticket state stays ticket
authority, and comments stay non-authoritative commentary

constraints.statement: Each tenant registry entry has stable identity and root/design/implementation locators; surfaces declare its binding under SPEC_METHOD §11. A companion or generated TENANT_REGISTRY.md cannot become another identity/location authority. Goals own work waves, tickets own ticket state and comments are non-authoritative. This section binds carrier locations; SPEC_METHOD §4 and TICKETS determine which carrier a work item uses.
constraints.uncertainty: The owning tenant-binding and carrier-selection rules are outside the supplied sections.

conditions: Selecting or resolving definitions and composition edges.

grounding.quote:
For a requested Product scope exactly one applicable definition is
selected; zero or several unresolved definitions fail closed, and a
symlinked definition is refused

Resolution verifies both the locator and the expected identity. Moving a
definition requires a locator update and does not change its identity.

constraints.statement: Select exactly one applicable definition per requested Product scope; zero or unresolved multiplicity fails closed and symlinked definitions are refused. Resolve both locator and expected stable identity. Moves require locator updates without identity change; replacing content at the same locator with another definition identity fails closed. If an edge binds exact immutable Product/release versions, relation and contracts must carry and verify them; mutable definition identity is no substitute.

conditions: A discovered set claims conformance.

grounding.quote: A conforming discovered set satisfies all of the following

constraints.statement: Every definition validates against its selected released schema; every required URI/fragment resolves inside declared workspace/resolver boundaries; definition IDs are unique and tenant IDs unique within overlays; every scope has an applicable resolvable frame basis, with overlap reconciled by cited authority; every disambiguation binds exact term/context, complete candidates, selected member, authority/basis/scope and a congruent carrier; every material cross-context seam uses an explicit import/disambiguation/translation/equivalence; every target resolves to another definition with the expected ID and resolvable relation/non-empty contracts; and no two carriers claim authority for the same Product, tenant, ticket state or constitutional relation.

conditions: Structural validation or conformance is claimed.
exceptions: JSON Schema uri and uri-reference formats are assertions only when the declared validator implements format assertion.

grounding.quote:
Portable Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema validation establishes structural shape.
The schema's `uri` and `uri-reference` formats are annotations unless the
declared validator implements format assertion.

constraints.statement: Draft 2020-12 validation establishes shape. Conformance additionally performs explicit RFC 3986 URI/URI-reference syntax assertion, followed separately by resolution, fragment existence, selected-release identity, cross-file uniqueness, constitutional sufficiency, semantic-resolution/cross-context completeness and authority congruence. Structural and semantic subsets are distinct claims.

conditions: Semantic-resolution conformance is evaluated.

grounding.quote:
Correct
downstream behaviour produced through a guessed meaning does not pass
semantic conformance

constraints.statement: A positive local case declares one context and resolves one concept; a positive cross-context case provides the complete authorised relation. Negative cases include zero candidates, multiple candidates after disambiguation, selection outside candidates, context-free glossary fallback, incomplete coordinates, authority/basis mismatch, undeclared loss and invalidated relations. Correct behavior reached through guessed meaning fails semantic conformance. CONFORMANCE may index but cannot redefine these cases.

conditions: Derived instructions are used within their declared scope.

grounding.quote:
A projected prohibition cannot lose its condition
or its lawful alternative, even when every source digest is correct.

constraints.statement: Derived/evidential/authoring surfaces cannot form a selectable partial constitution or reinterpret owners. Derived instructions preserve applicability, obligations, permissions, exclusions, decision owners and invalidators, including conditions and lawful alternatives to prohibitions. Correct digests do not establish that preservation. Summaries, bootstraps and indexes cannot strengthen or weaken relations by compression. References must resolve within declared actor access, otherwise required meaning is supplied directly.

conditions: A released cut or installation carries derived surfaces.

grounding.quote:
Each carries the
path and digest of each deciding source it was derived from, and of each
index it watches

constraints.statement: Compressions, templates, bootstraps, indexes and projected frames carry paths/digests for every deciding source and watched index. Any changed digest makes the surface stale; regeneration or explicit re-acceptance is required before an installation treats it as current. Raw owning members of the same selected cut remain deciding authority for questions a stale or insufficient carrier cannot decide. ACTIVATION §2 owns general staleness and standalone scope; matching-digest standing is referred to EVALUATION §7.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete external staleness, standalone-scope and matching-digest rules are not supplied.

exceptions: A concrete form is method law when explicitly accepted as an interoperability boundary.
Creating executable or consumer-realisation STDO Product scope requires separate explicit human authorisation.

grounding.quote:
A shared-method amendment cannot create an executable tool, workflow
engine, runtime, assurance system or consumer realisation as STDO Product
scope without separate explicit human authorisation.

constraints.statement: The method owns normative construction algebra, authority relations, abstract states/transitions, admissibility, necessary causal order and evidence invariants; consumers own instantiated types/schemas, files, tools, runtime/orchestration, tests and executable conformance. Explicit interoperability acceptance is needed to make a concrete form method law, as stated for the definition schema/template. An agent recording a ruling cannot widen subject, implication, authority or change class. Only released versions confer publication authority; mutable source authors future cuts and must not silently govern consumers.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced §1 interoperability declaration is outside this source slice.

exceptions: An explicitly bound and verified project-local exact copy is lawful but non-default.

grounding.quote:
A project creates no competing local methodology root, such as a default
`specification/standards/`, and binds no mutable or partial method source
as if it were the selected immutable release

constraints.statement: Mutable method authoring governs a future candidate in the method source workspace; released authority is the consumer-selected immutable version; installed distribution defaults to the shared store matching basis URI and manifest digest; Product constitutional surfaces live at what bindings and realisation/work at how/ticketing. No competing local methodology root or mutable/partial source may masquerade as the immutable release. Mutable source during editing/repricing is candidate-authoring authority, not operative consumer law before release and explicit selection. The resolved installed basis remains operative until explicit adoption of another cut; proximity cannot choose a local copy.

conditions: Following the source-defined bootstrap sequence.

grounding.quote:
The bootstrap sequence is (P3, P6, P2):

1. Install the STDO toolchain manager once, resolve one version-line
   selector, and explicitly select one immutable RC cut.
2. Install that complete cut in the shared release store and retain its
   deterministic installed-manifest digest.

14. Validate the JSON shape, assert URI and URI-reference syntax,
    synchronise and verify the exact installed basis, then resolve every
    URI and perform the cross-definition identity, composition,
    constitutional-sufficiency and authority-congruence checks.

constraints.statement: The described order is: (1) install manager once, resolve version-line selector, explicitly choose immutable RC; (2) install complete cut and retain deterministic manifest digest; (3) copy exact-cut template with prescribed definition filename; (4) assign stable mutable definition-line ID, source-project locator and context, distinct from immutable Product/release IDs; (5) bind source, non-operative selector, exact basis/digest, all additional authorities and basis-qualified entrypoints, confirming collective axioms/ontology/epistemology/taxonomy/semantics; (6) bind agent entrypoint/portable targets relative to resolved source_project, preflight all targets and change only marker-bounded discovery blocks; (7) bind or explicitly empty local collections; (8) bind at least one accepted collective frame basis with authorities/scope; (9) confirm Goals, run goals→intent→product and bind entrypoints; (10) gather/derive/classify/bind live requirements without co-equal rival; (11) bind at least one tenant with root/design/implementation and any shared law; (12) bind Goals, ticket lanes, comments and optional sprint root; (13) explicitly bind every known composition edge with expected ID, authority and non-empty contracts; (14) validate shape, assert URI syntax, sync/verify exact basis, resolve every URI and check cross-definition identity, composition, sufficiency and congruence.
constraints.uncertainty: The sequence is represented as source-defined ordered data, not executed.

conditions: A bound requirement set is the live constitutional surface.

grounding.quote:
Once a bound requirement set is the live constitutional surface, no rival
monolithic requirements document should remain co-equal authority with it.

constraints.statement: No rival monolithic requirements document should remain co-equal authority with the live bound set; this recommendation preserves structurally clear, derivable, non-monolithic requirement truth without prescribing folders.
constraints.uncertainty: The source uses should here; it is retained as a recommendation.

exceptions: Externally owned terms may occur in core disposition tables.
Traversal records and F_D, F_P and F_H are tier-1 calculus terms, and generic module is unrestricted.

grounding.quote: The core names no runtime, no carrier and no executor.

constraints.statement: Externally owned profile/realisation/rc.2 terms do not enter tiers 1 or 2 except disposition tables: graph, edge, vector, ledger, event log, worksite, HoG, Markov overlay, screen, entity cut, IACS and Prime. Preserve the explicit calculus/generic-module exceptions. Profile mechanism binding, Product adoption binding and typed carrier-contract binding are not interchangeable. Worked applications, hello worlds and data mappers remain external test subjects whose particulars cannot become generic method functionality by precedent.

conditions: A profile uses core concepts or refines another profile.

grounding.quote:
A profile that refines
another profile declares the refinement in its lead; the refined profile
keeps its rules, and the refining profile owns only what it adds

constraints.statement: Profiles import each used tier-1/2 concept under FOUNDATIONS §2 and the generic families on which their rules rest, restating none of the owning member's rules. They own only added domain/operational terms, choices and bindings. Their FOUNDATIONS-format family tables name every imported family's ID and table section in the premise column; rules rest on those consequences with their owner's standing, and family rules/choices retain owners. Refinement must be declared in the lead; the refined profile retains its rules. No generic rule acquires a second owner and no added profile choice is presented as following from foundations.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete FOUNDATIONS import/table rules are not supplied.

conditions: A predecessor row contributes to a qualification claim.

grounding.quote:
Every row's disposition is one of the four values of
[RELEASE §9](RELEASE.md#9-successor-baseline-conservation-stdo-up-015); a
row with none is unresolved, which blocks qualification of the claim it
affects.

constraints.statement: Every predecessor row must have one of RELEASE §9's four disposition values; absent disposition means unresolved and blocks qualification of the affected claim. Proposed supersession pending the Product owner is not completed supersession.
constraints.uncertainty: The four-value domain is referenced but not enumerated in the supplied source.

conditions: A task acquires a derived context surface.

grounding.quote: It is an optional derived surface under ACTIVATION §2 Acquisition; for a task it does not cover, acquire the deciding owner sections. Earlier sets under `a_c/` are historical and are not current

constraints.statement: Use a derived surface whose sources are current when it serves the task; otherwise acquire deciding owner sections. Verbatim frames and constraint surfaces projected from a current a_c interpretation are possible derived surfaces. a_c/i3 is optional and bounded by its README's subject, coverage and insufficiencies; uncovered tasks require owners, and historical a_c sets are not current.
constraints.uncertainty: The i3 README and task-specific owner sections are not supplied.

exceptions: Tier-3 profiles become constitutional members when selected by a project.

grounding.quote:
A clause that restates or supersedes an rc.2 clause
may carry that clause's route as provenance; a route is not a
disposition

constraints.statement: Tier-1/2 standards are constitutional members, with selected tier-3 profiles. Each clause names its requiring principle. Predecessor provenance routes are not dispositions; each receiving member records dispositions in its last section and the frontier records every predecessor disposition/locus. The corpus is described as applicable without the predecessor cut, while rc.2 remains this construction's operative builder until release. Verbatim frames own no determinations and become stale when source digests mismatch.
constraints.uncertainty: Applicability stated here does not negate the separately stated unreleased candidate status.

conditions: Installing or selecting a consumer basis.
exceptions: A project-local copy is possible when explicitly bound and verified, but is not the default.

grounding.quote:
Installed bytes take their authority from the exact RC cut, the product
definition's basis URI, the manifest digest and the member inventory

constraints.statement: The manager installs each complete immutable cut once in a shared versioned store and resolves logical release URIs. Definitions name logical basis URI and manifest digest, not machine-local paths. Installed-byte authority derives jointly from exact RC cut, basis URI, manifest digest and member inventory. Neither mutable authoring head nor moving version-line selector silently replaces the consumer basis. Carrying a traversal profile changes neither calculus nor consumer selection and leaves adoption optional.

grounding.quote:
Other members and products may import or
specialise its relations under their own authority, and that external
relation neither enters nor amends this member

constraints.statement: Selection, activation, evaluation, conjunction, translation, coverage and revision remain separate functions. A bounded frame need not first contain a universal relationship theory. Engagement atomicity does not collapse internal semantic atoms or owners. External imports/specialisations operate under their owners and do not enter or amend this member. Same-spelled profile, Product, role or runtime carriers are not imported by proximity or nominal match.

conditions: REFERENCE_FRAME uses imported concepts or states refinements.

grounding.quote:
A refinement this member states, such as the function outcomes of §5
or the coverage statuses of §8, names its owner in this table and maps
back to it.

constraints.statement: Imports run from each named source member to reference-frame-evaluation with no loss, ownership transfer or conferred authority. Imported concepts are not defined a second time despite overlapping category names in the local scope. Local function-result and coverage-status refinements name and map back to their owners. Profile/Product frame families declared in this context are their owners' specialisations, not imports into this member. The new declaration aims to retain one owning section per concept.
constraints.uncertainty: The imported definitions and later function/coverage refinements are not supplied.

dispositions.reason: Retains plan, authority, effect, refusal and recovery distinctions; earlier command/hash contracts remain unresolved.
Retains semantic addresses, exact resolution, fail-closed outcomes and relation-kind boundaries, with external owner-law dependency explicit.
Retains required local binding coordinates, carrier ownership and empty-versus-omitted distinction.
Retains durable basis, temporary activation, adoption authority, Product-role mapping and template latitude without instantiation.
Retains cardinalities, locator roles and authority boundaries; externally owned binding and selection laws remain references.
Retains discovery boundaries, explicit composition, identity checks and distinct structural/semantic conformance claims.
Retains all five collision families and required positive and negative coverage without reporting conformance.
Retains singular release authority, derived-surface fidelity/staleness and explicit realisation-authorisation boundary.
Retains defaults, authority split, fourteen-step source sequence and recommendation strength; preserves tension between usual and sequenced Goals derivation.
Retains the stated row dispositions, renamed carriers and new-law claims without establishing predecessor conservation.
Retains profile identity, tier and core-boundary ownership.
Retains binding meanings, vocabulary exceptions, import/refinement ownership and external-example boundary.
Retains indexed graph bindings and optional occurrence signature, with pending supersession and unavailable owner details explicit.
Retains the binding inventory and named ownership of derivation cost, evidence and core non-goals.
Retains scoped design refinement, UX binding inventory and result/escrow ownership.
Retains candidate construct status, binding inventory, core-result mapping and absence of core dependence.
Retains optional configuration, engagement/specialist frames and non-nominal responsibility binding.
Retains source disposition routes, withdrawal, new rules and unresolved owner rulings without qualification.
Retains candidate status, exact builder basis and finite-actor methodology purpose.
Retains ordered navigation for every listed task, without importing unseen target laws or activating any route.
Retains tier/owner map, frame-task catalogue and historical/current distinctions while leaving unseen bodies and partial interpretation limits unresolved.
Retains member kinds, optional tooling/profile adoption and installed-basis authority; compact-read-model carrier remains pending.
Retains claimed conservation and explicit generalisations without resolving pending compression carriers or validating predecessor equivalence.
Retains engagement-law scope, imported ownership and provenance-only predecessor routes.
Retains finite-actor purpose, engagement atomicity, context scope and substrate freedom without constructing an activated frame.
Retains exact named import populations, direction and no-loss/no-authority boundary; imported owner definitions are unavailable.

allowed: Change only selected basis/schema, existing composition locators/contracts, and selected native/install links.
Leave newly staged immutable installs unused after refusal or failure.
forbidden: Repair existing immutable installs in place.
Change historical installs or unrelated consumer content.
Change Product meaning or local semantic maps.

grounding.quote:
Only the selected basis and schema, the existing
composition locators and contracts, and the selected native and install
links may change; historical installs and unrelated consumer content stay
available and unchanged. It creates no consumer-local checker and changes
no Product meaning or local semantic map

allowed: Adopt an available profile or define a project configuration.
Express an accepted basis entirely as source-linked prose.
Let several agents activate overlapping frame subsets and one agent activate different frames over time.
forbidden: Treat the starter template as authority.
Require a schema, axiomatic representation, prompt framework or runtime frame engine merely to use the method.

grounding.quote:
It may adopt an available
profile or define a project configuration.

An accepted Project Reference-Frame Basis may be expressed entirely as
source-linked prose.

allowed: Resolve work bindings to directories, repository resources, tracker collections, API endpoints or Product-scoped queries.
Keep a human-readable or generated tenant-registry companion.
forbidden: Promote the registry companion to a second tenant identity/location authority.

grounding.quote:
These bindings may resolve to directories,
repository resources, tracker collections, API endpoints or product-scoped
queries.

allowed: Bind existing layouts without moving, renaming or duplicating authority/realisation surfaces.
Place several named definitions at one root with distinct WHATs, or one or more at nested roots.
Start without a complete requirements tree.

Source requirements from any legitimate constitutional input regardless of path, including Goals, Intent, Product, existing requirements, imported standards/policy, prior versions and migration/repricing material.
Use the usual Goals→Intent→Product→requirements starting path without treating it as the only lawful source.
forbidden: Treat default folder topology as a conformance requirement.
Infer Product composition from directory nesting.

grounding.quote:
A project need not start with a complete `requirements/` tree on day zero.
Requirements may be sourced from any legitimate constitutional input
regardless of its path,
This is a starter topology, not a conformance requirement.

allowed: Represent a frame in prose, structured data, a prompt, design asset, typed carrier, runtime context or any other consumer-selected form.
forbidden: Make a class, aggregate, actor, controller, service, registry, graph or frame engine a required substrate.

grounding.quote:
Substrate. A reference frame may be represented in prose, structured data,
a prompt, a design asset, a typed carrier, a runtime context or any other
form its consumer selects. No class, aggregate, actor, controller, service,
registry, graph or frame engine is required

limitations: This is an F_P interpretation of the 26 supplied sections under the selected published STDO 2.5.1-rc.2 basis, not semantic acceptance, execution, installed qualification or a completeness judgment.
No tools, external files, project instructions, web sources or agents were used. Graph discovery supplies no normative evidence; absent one-hop nodes were not fabricated into governing endpoints.

Earlier PRODUCT_DEFINITION sections, the published calculus body, FOUNDATIONS, ACTIVATION, EVALUATION, RELEASE, SPEC_METHOD, TICKETS and profile owner bodies are not supplied. Their named roles and local consequences are retained, but their complete laws, algorithms, signatures and proof obligations remain unresolved.

Navigation tables, member inventories and source dispositions are compacted into named concept records. This preserves their stated purposes and ownership routing without reproducing every table cell or turning routes into law, predecessor conservation proofs or executable procedures.

Ordered resolution, bootstrap, update, evaluation and result-mapping descriptions are represented as concepts and constraints. No judgment, traversal or transformation population is instantiated; these remain empty in the adapter, and no transition, rollback, validation or evaluation was performed.
Source-defined pending supersessions, missing dispositions, candidate construct status and partial-interpretation limits remain unresolved; none is converted to falsity or acceptance.

The source's general latitude for requirement inputs and its ordered bootstrap instruction to run Goals→Intent→Product are both retained; their application to every existing-project case is not decided here.
Disposition retained or residual records this bounded processing choice and does not certify semantic completeness or predecessor conservation.
